prior_finding_closed_sinks_bui08.note: First build left terminal sinks closed (no outlet): Bui08 flood volume was ~3,000 m3, 66% from ONE node (N2125, a 5 m-deep siphon-like dead end at canal level). Treated as a modelling artifact, not a flood; sinks now drain freely (an OPTIMISTIC assumption: real pumps have finite capacity).
